.claude/docs/conventions.md: - Architecture: `.andromeda/architecture.md` · directory layout: §Infrastructure Patterns · gotchas: `.claude/docs/gotchas.md` · per-crate notes: `.claude/docs/services/`.

.claude/docs/workflow.md: A reference-based CLAUDE.md: a thin index, with depth in `.claude/docs/` (on demand) and `.claude/rules/` (path-scoped).

.claude/docs/services/escher-driver.md: - The command line, through the real `escher-session` binary (seven_guis, unix only): `host_binary` (the host role on `counter`; a host that cannot serve; nine argv rows that are no command), `host_log` (a host on `crud` at `RUST_LOG=trace` while three calls run: one span line per call, no id, name or typed text, under both builds; since 2026-10-19-session-recording a second test, a recording host reading 0 of the recording needles — the kept check's names and its directory's name — on stderr), `host_timer` (the timer host moved by a hosted `advance`), `cli_commands` (every driver command as a process on the four tasks: fields, refusals by status `1`, usage by `2`, session errors by `3`) and `cli_flow` (two POSIX `sh` flows, `counter.sh` and `flight.sh`); since 2026-10-19-session-recording `recording` (4 tests, unix only, and 1 off-unix; 3 until 2026-10-19-recorded-check-replay: the command line and the `mcp` role keep the same check byte for byte, the state directory gone after `stop`; a recording directory open to its group refused before anything runs; the `mcp` role's listing and `help` the same with and without `--record`; since 2026-10-19-recorded-check-replay the committed checks what the binary records, `tests/flows/record_checks.sh` run through the binary and both files compared byte for byte with the committed copies; off unix, `--record` refused `Unsupported`); since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface `mcp_server` (the `mcp` role completes the Counter flow by tool calls alone; a `lint` tool call answering its line of findings; protocol errors run nothing and leak nothing; unix only, a snapshot equal through MCP and the command line) and `mcp_log` (the role at `RUST_LOG=trace`: no id, name or typed text, one `tool_call` line per call, under both builds; since 2026-10-19-session-recording a second test, a recording `mcp` role that logs nothing of its checks), not unix-gated but the comparison and, since that chunk, every check that records (`mcp_log`'s recorded test, the shared `common::recorded_needles` (its own until 2026-10-19-test-splits), `the_check`) — and in process `stand_mcp_tools` (blitz-tests; the flow through `serve_mcp` in both layout modes, one `tool_call` span the parent of each `command`; since 2026-10-19-visual-lint a `lint` tool call answering the reader's findings and parenting its `command` span; since 2026-10-12-self-description every cause a tool call reaches served with its remedy, `covered` on an overlay fixture, and `help` answered by the server, parenting no `command` span) and, since 2026-10-12-self-description, `stand_mcp_masked` (a password typed through an MCP `type` reads `MASKED_VALUE` and never the typed text, role `PasswordInput` with a non-empty name, in both layout modes; it declares no `mod session_common;`). Mutation controls in `escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-mcp-surface/evidence/controls.md` (five).

.claude/docs/commands.md: - Fonts missing in headless tests → `system-fonts` feature / fontconfig installed; stand checks need neither — they boot with the bundled DejaVu Sans (`seven_guis::stand::options`)

.claude/rules/security.md: - 2026-10-15: A listener or env read that only a test makes — served by no binary, reached by no caller — is no crossing and not the founder's call, yet it is registered as test-only in arch §Occupied Resources and the security plan's environment values before it lands, as `PAINT_TREE_BENCH_HTML` and `CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR` are (the operator's answer, 2026-10-15).

.claude/rules/testing.md: - 2026-10-19: Code compiled only off unix is unverified on this linux host until a non-unix build reads it — after adding or moving a `#[cfg(unix)]` gate (a file-wide `#![cfg(unix)]` split into per-item gates included), run `cargo check --tests --locked --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu -p {crate}` before pushing: a helper left calling a gated item compiles here and breaks only the windows job, and `cfg_attr(…, allow(dead_code))` cannot excuse a call to an item configured out.
.claude/rules/verification-harness.md: - 2026-10-06: A boot smoke bounded by `timeout N` exits 124 when the stand stays up, but the Andromeda gate tool reads any entry exit 124 or 137 as its own bound firing (`timeout`), so `expect = ['exit 124']` never reads green — author the entry so its own exit is 0 on the stay-up case, or drive it by hand and record its exit and atoms under the chunk's `evidence/`.

.claude/rules/observability.md: - 2026-10-06: With the workspace's tracing 0.1.44, `tracing::error!(target: "…", a.b = x, "msg")` does not parse dotted field names (local macro ambiguity) and rejects string-literal keys — write `tracing::event!(target: "…", tracing::Level::ERROR, { a.b = x }, "msg")`.

.claude/rules/a11y.md: - 2026-10-06: On the dev host the AT-SPI bus reads `IsEnabled` false, so AccessKit's `update_if_active` never runs the tree build in a windowed boot — a windowed smoke proves the boot only; prove tree output headlessly through `Document::accessibility_tree`, and leave the bus flag alone (the operator's desktop state).
